tasks.short: Watch the equipment and tell the operator.

steps.what: Read the watch card before this round.
Observe equipment operations so that malfunctions can be detected.
outputs: what the helper saw on the equipment

inputs: what the helper saw on the equipment

tasks.design: A line colleague writes a watch card before the round. The card holds the equipment name, the station, and the last note title. The production helper reads the card, then still watches the equipment and tells the operator what was seen. If the card has no row, the helper reads the paper station list inside the same step.
tasks.previous_blocker: The station sat in a folder the helper opened at the start of the round.
tasks.enabler_now: A paper watch card with the equipment name, the station, and the last note title is enough to start. No system is required.
tasks.still_hard: Watching the equipment and telling the operator still take the time.
tasks.human_edge: Only the helper can judge what is wrong on the equipment in the moment.
tasks.altitude: A card shortens finding the station. The helper still watches the equipment and tells the operator.

reach.task: Watch one station during a round
reach.learn: The card names the station. The assembler still watches the equipment.

reach.role: Inspectors, Testers, Sorters, Samplers, and Weighers
reach.task: Tell an operator what was seen
reach.learn: The words to the operator stay with the person on the line.

evidence.claim: A paper card with the equipment name, the station, and the last note title shortens the search when the row is there. The helper still watches the equipment and tells the operator. Model knowledge.

assumptions: The workplace is a mid-size European production floor.
A line colleague writes the watch card before the round.
Fields are the equipment name, the station, and the last note title.
The helper watches the equipment and tells the operator at full time.
If the row is missing, the helper reads the paper station list inside s1.
There is no native system to configure and no custom code.
Focal upkeep is zero because a line colleague keeps the card, counted on the other line.
Works-council consultation for a monitoring or scoring tool is out of scope because this design adds none.
unknowns: Whether this floor already keeps a one-line watch card for each station.
research_questions: How often a first round has no row on the watch card.

incremental.description: No extra helper upkeep. A line colleague keeps the watch card.
A line colleague writes the watch card: equipment name, station, and last note title.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The round is the first one, so the watch card has no row and the helper reads the paper station list. The search saving disappears.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write the count, the reading, and the time.

steps.what: Read the count card before this tally.
Record information, such as the number of products tested, meter readings, or dates and times of product production.

tasks.design: A line colleague writes a count card before the tally. The card holds the product name, the meter name, and the count title. The production helper reads the card, then still writes the number of products tested, the meter reading, and the date and time by hand. If the card has no row, the helper reads the paper count list inside the same step.

tasks.enabler_now: A paper count card with the product name, the meter name, and the count title is enough to start. No system is required.
tasks.still_hard: Writing the count, the meter reading, and the date and time still takes the time.
tasks.human_edge: Only the helper can write the number, the reading, and the time that were just seen.
tasks.altitude: A card shortens finding the meter. The helper still writes the count, the reading, and the time.

reach.task: Write a production count after a batch
reach.learn: The card names the meter. The batchmaker still writes the count.
